answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 1353 Country: India Title: I am working as a property dealer, is it haram or halal? Question: I am working as a property dealer, is it haram or halal? Answer ID: 1353 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 805/805=J) Business of property dealer is lawful provided it involves no cheating and deception. Likewise, the bayana amount (which is taken by buyer in advance) in case the buyer fails to pay the amount is not returned, this is haram . The amount belongs to buyer; therefore if he is unable to purchase, the amount should be returned to him. This amount is not halal for the seller. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
